# convergent-disciplines-lab

> A machine-readable reasoning discipline for AI systems that work across disciplines and
> traditions: the method and fifty-eight operational lessons of "The Convergent Threads: A
> Synthesis for the Age of Mind" (CC-BY-SA-4.0), with data contracts, drop-in prompts, a
> reference implementation and adoption instructions. The lessons are rules with tests, not a
> certification, and they never override an existing safety policy.

Read first: the ingest protocol in threads/threads.json (key "ingest_protocol"), then the method lessons M1-M7.

## Data

- [threads/threads.json](threads/threads.json): registers, method, convergences, disagreements, moral convergences and disagreements, frameworks, 58 lessons, glossary, ingest protocol, limits
- [threads/threads.schema.json](threads/threads.schema.json): schema for threads.json
- [threads/schemas/](threads/schemas/): ten data contracts for answers, claims, convergences, disagreements, explanations, dialogues, decisions, design reviews, consensus and agent policies
- [threads/README.md](threads/README.md): field-by-field description

## Prompts

- [threads/prompts/threads-system-prompt.md](threads/prompts/threads-system-prompt.md): drop-in system prompt (seventeen rules)
- [threads/prompts/threads-agent-addendum.md](threads/prompts/threads-agent-addendum.md): addendum for tool-using and multi-agent systems
- [threads/prompts/README.md](threads/prompts/README.md): what a prompt can and cannot carry; six probes

## Code

- [projects/2026-10-23_threadkit/](projects/2026-10-23_threadkit/): reference implementation and CLI (standard-library Python)

## Docs

- [docs/IMPLEMENTING.md](docs/IMPLEMENTING.md): how to adopt the threads, layer by layer
- [docs/ARCHITECTURE.md](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): the architecture and its trust boundaries
- [docs/WHAT-AI-GAINS.md](docs/WHAT-AI-GAINS.md): failure modes, lessons, tests
- [docs/LESSONS.md](docs/LESSONS.md): the full catalogue in Markdown (generated)
- [docs/RESEARCH.md](docs/RESEARCH.md): the book's method and argument, and how this lab read it
- [NOTICE.md](NOTICE.md): source, licence (ShareAlike) and changes
